protocol.scope: offline development study; no original validation/test features, motion, predictions or evaluation results loaded

development_split.rule: sorted six source IDs/class; class SHA256 seed documented in development_split.json; random.Random.shuffle; first four train

protocol.arithmetic: float64 distances, population scaling, ridge fitting and metrics; original saved reference arrays float32
protocol.scaling: train-only population mean/std, std<=1e-12 -> scale=1; unpenalized intercept
protocol.drift_training: all r<t pairs: 120 per video, 9,600 from 80 videos; original appearance-feature drift target
protocol.action_value_training: all reachable feasible states from (1,0,B-1); only states with both actions feasible; separate models per B
protocol.V: minimum SUM from t onward with exactly b remaining refreshes; terminal V(16,r,0)=0, other terminal b infeasible
protocol.action_value_target: refresh_advantage=(Q_reuse-Q_refresh)/16; signed, distinct from drift; future RGB is permitted for TRAINING labels only
protocol.value_decision: optional refresh iff raw signed predicted advantage >0; threshold fixed zero, no clipping or tuning
protocol.exact_budget: first refresh mandatory and counted; b=0 requires reuse; b=16-t requires refresh; cache/motion interval reset on actual refresh
protocol.threshold_grid: unique TRAINING-score linear quantiles 0%,5%,...,100%; always/wait kind with value=null
protocol.drift_score: clip predictions to [0,2]; recompute age/motion from current actual cache; optional refresh iff score >= threshold
protocol.privileged_score: actual pre-decision D[t,r], with grid from training-pair actual drift; unavailable without fresh RGB, not an upper bound
protocol.selection: lowest equal-video mean development error; within 1e-12 of minimum prefer smaller lambda, then earlier base grid order; coefficients frozen
protocol.random_rule: mandatory 0 + random.Random.sample(1..15,B-1); seed first16 SHA256 hex of budget_aware_refresh_v2|random|seed|sourceID; all10 seeds averaged within video
protocol.motion_intervals: strictly after actual cached frame through current frame inclusive; equal frame weights when available; missing magnitudes zero with explicit availability
protocol.metric: mean POST-decision output-feature cosine error over all16 candidates; equal weight/video
protocol.comparisons: periodic-policy per video; percentages per video before means; oracle gap closure=(periodic-policy)/(periodic-oracle); null if denominator<=1e-12; no clipping
protocol.action_regret: (Q_chosen-min_feasible_Q)/16, evaluator only; summed regrets equal mean-error excess over exact oracle
protocol.oracle: existing exhaustive full-future schedules cross-checked with exact DP; lexicographic tie within1e-12
protocol.example_rule: B4 value_age_motion_budget largest absolute gain and largest loss versus periodic, source-ID tie break; descriptive only
limitations: development settings selected on evaluated development videos
zero actual encoder calls and no latency measurements
offline: full-clip candidates and future-reference codec vectors
privileged future RGB trains oracle labels
states from one video are correlated
